corrections.proposed: 1935 built (residence cabin, garage and exposed fire-finder stand), plus 1940 built (enclosed 6x6 ground lookout house)
corrections.why: NHLR and firelookout.com date the enclosed lookout house to 1940; the 1935 date covers the cabin, garage and open fire-finder stand.
No page read gives a height for this site. 1.8 m is about 6 feet, the width of the 6x6 ft ground cab, so the figure may be a dimension entered as a height.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record gives 1935 and NHLR gives 'Built 1935 & 1940'. The 1935 date covers the cabin, garage and fire-finder stand; 1940 covers the enclosed lookout house.
NHLR titles it Mackay Butte Lookout - Norcross Station; contemporary media and the Forest Lookouts page use Mackey Butte; firelookout.com uses Mackey (Norcross) Butte.

notes_for_editor: The 1950s abandonment is given only as a decade, so the year 1950 in events is a placeholder. The 1925 fireman posting is a plan from a July 1925 report, not confirmed by NHLR or firelookout.com, so no staffed_first event is recorded. The Forest Lookouts page shows a 'Removed' label next to the site after its photo credits; its meaning is unclear and it conflicts with NHLR and firelookout.com, which both describe standing structures, so 'standing' is kept with a note. The record's height_m 1.8 is not supported by any page read. NHLR photo credits (1940 and 1955 Forest Service) are not added as new finds.
